qa_pair.question: What is the model name of the connected oscilloscope?
What firmware version is the oscilloscope running?
What is the frequency of the signal on channel 1, in kilohertz, rounded to one decimal place?
What is the duty cycle of the signal on channel 1, in percent, rounded to the nearest multiple of 10?
What is the period of the signal on channel 1, in milliseconds, rounded to one decimal place?
How many of the oscilloscope's four channels are currently enabled?
Which channel is the trigger source set to? Answer with the channel name, e.g. C3.
What waveform type is the built-in generator set to? Answer with one word in upper case.
The generator output is wired to channel 2. What frequency does the scope measure on channel 2, in kilohertz, rounded to one decimal place?
What output load setting is the generator configured for? Answer HZ (high impedance) or 50.
